name: H6-1 development experiment (not a task evaluation)
context: P6 confirmed NO_GAIN. User decision: run H6-1 as a development experiment; do not claim task performance; measure goal interpretation, page selection, candidate generation and evidence judgement separately; check transfer to unseen documents with the teacher off; if results stay weak, re-examine the assumption that free English web reading is reachable with the current small learner instead of iterating thresholds.
change: H6-1: during training the teacher (a) locates the official name on every page ATANOR opened (span annotation -> learned span model), (b) marks opened pages and up to 3 unopened search results as about-this-format or not (counterexamples -> learned page relevance used to order results), (c) annotates cue words in 81 goal sentences (36 P6 + 45 new contrastive). Training formats, web policy, budgets and fs rules are the same as P6.
transfer_set: 44 formats never taught: 40 training-only Wikidata formats held out from training + 4 P6 dev formats (results/h6-dev/reference.json); P6 evaluation pool untouched

sentences.written_by: an agent without the teacher's context; original published only after measurement

conditions.baseline: P6 frozen training state (results/p6-train/state.json) with the H6 code (learned span/page models empty -> P6 behaviour)

measures: 1 interpretation accuracy (unclear counts as wrong) on the 45 independent sentences
2 page selection: share of formats where >= 1 opened page is relevant (contains extension and an accepted name)
3 candidate generation: accepted name among candidates on relevant pages it opened
3' given the right page (the format's English Wikipedia article): candidate present / ranked first / trusted / trusted but wrong
4 evidence judgement: per format correct / wrong / abstain, precision and recall

development_success.given_right_page: candidate present >= 0.8 of formats AND trusted-and-first >= 0.5 AND trusted-but-wrong <= 0.1
development_success.page_selection: >= 0.6 of formats open a relevant page

weak_rule: if 2 or more of the 4 stage criteria fail after H6-1, the result is WEAK: no threshold re-tuning; the report re-examines the assumption that free English web reading is reachable with the current small learner
teacher_off: measurement runs in a separate process with the teacher import guard and LLM/localhost host block; attempts are recorded
known_limits: the 4 dev formats were seen in the P6 dev check (not taught); the 40 held-out ones were never seen
relevance of a page is judged by string presence of an accepted name and the extension
transfer set accepted names come from Wikidata labels (looser filters for the 40 training-only formats)
